purpose: Administrative geographic distribution audit only; this geometry is not walking-route evidence.
replay_algorithm: For each way, iterate consecutive coordinate pairs without adding a closing edge. x=longitude, y=latitude. A segment crosses the east-going horizontal ray if (ay>y)!=(by>y) and x<ax+(y-ay)*(bx-ax)/(by-ay). Count outer and inner crossings separately; a point is inside iff outer_count%2==1 and inner_count%2==0. Require exactly one district; detect boundary points separately. Every relation outer/inner member way and its nodes is included; shared segments between separate districts are intentionally repeated.
